method: Handle supported row strides, pixel strides, crop rectangles, and chroma layout explicitly. Validate alignment and bounds. Keep limited-range luma and chroma quantization formulas distinct. Unknown plane configurations are rejected, not guessed.
fixture: Padded luma and chroma rows with known endpoint codes and a nonzero crop rectangle.
oracle: An independent unpacker reconstructs exact intended codes while guard bytes and padding remain untouched.
mutant: Store ten-bit codes in the low bits of each sixteen-bit word.
